summary: Iteration 4 refinements testing (both backend + frontend). All 4 features verified end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 new pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_features.py (pots-summary history array per pot; dashboard.category_items map with description+amount and months[].per_person[pid].net; bouwdepot-summary depots[].checks contain termijn_due warning for near-due unpaid factuur and termijn_overdue error for past due_date). Frontend E2E (owner login robeson.constantine@gmail.com): (1) Pots page shows 4 pot-card items each with pot-history-{id} area sparkline below balance; (2) Dashboard months-table now has per-person columns Robeson & Miraja with green/red net values (Jan example: Robeson €2.294, Miraja €1.826); (3) Dashboard category pie is clickable - iterated 8 sectors: opens category-detail-dialog titled by category with listed descriptions. Verified 'Uit eten' dialog shows exactly 'Restaurant verjaardag €128' + 'Afhaal weekend €54'; 'Boodschappen' shows 'Boodschappen budget €7.800 + Extra feestdagen €190'; all 8 categories render correctly; (4) Created via API a TEST_ui_quote offerte + factuur due 2026-10-01 (5 days ahead, not submitted) + factuur due 2026-09-16 (overdue 10 days). Navigated to bouwdepot control-check-warning-panel: both amber 'Termijn van TEST_ui_quote vervalt over 5 dagen en is nog niet ingediend bij de bank' warning and red 'Termijn van TEST_ui_quote is 10 dagen over de vervaldatum en nog niet betaald' error render. Cleaned up all test invoices. Language toggle (data-testid=language-toggle) works. No JS crashes; only benign Recharts width/height warnings on first mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses Dutch strings for invoice type ('offerte'/'factuur') and status ('geaccepteerd') - this must be respected by any future test/dev; the initial iteration_3 pytest used 'quote'/'invoice'/'accepted' and only appeared to pass because a naive string-scan matched the description text. Fixed in iter4 tests: pytest now uses correct 'factuur'/'offerte' and asserts on depots[].checks[].code directly.
Server 'today' is real container clock (2026-09-26) - tests should use dt.date.today() rather than hard-coded anchors so termijn day-diff math works.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_ui_quote offerte + 2 termijn facturen created via API to trigger termijn reminders; all deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice type values in DB are Dutch: 'offerte' (quote) and 'factuur' (invoice); status for accepted quote is 'geaccepteerd'. Server today is real container time (2026-09 as of testing). Pie sector selector: [data-testid="category-pie"] .recharts-pie-sector - iterate .nth(i).click(force=True) then close with Escape; state re-renders detach nodes so re-resolve locator each iteration. Control panel testid=control-check-warning-panel with per-item testid control-check-{code}-{i}.
